name: Nishimatsuya Chain Co., Ltd.
summary: Nishimatsuya Chain Co., Ltd. operates a chain of specialty stores for baby/children's living goods in Japan and Taiwan. The company offers newborn and baby clothes; children's wear, such as baby outerwear, girl's outerwear, underwear, and pajamas; school uniforms; maternity products, nursing clothes, and mom goods; and fashion goods. The company also offers general merchandise, bedding, strollers, car seats and other travel items, indoor mats, chairs, racks, walkers, hats, shoes, and rain gear, toys, and gift sets, as well as traditional Japanese clothing. It operates various stores. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Himeji, Japan.
